title: Dry spells and global crop production: a multi-stressor and multi-timescale analysis
When and where to protect forests
Biodiversity as insurance: from concept to measurement and application
abstract: Biological insurance theory predicts that, in a variable environment, aggregate ecosystem properties will vary less in more diverse communities because declines in the performance or abundance of some species or phenotypes will be offset, at least partly, by smoother declines or increases in others. During the past two decades, ecology has accumulated strong evidence for the stabilising effect of biodiversity on ecosystem functioning. As biological insurance is reaching the stage of a mature theory, it is critical to revisit and clarify its conceptual foundations to guide future developments, applications and measurements. In this review, we first clarify the connections between the insurance and portfolio concepts that have been used in ecology and the economic concepts that inspired them. Doing so points to gaps and mismatches between ecology and economics that could be filled profitably by new theoretical developments and new management applications. Second, we discuss some fundamental issues in biological insurance theory that have remained unnoticed so far and that emerge from some of its recent applications. In particular, we draw a clear distinction between the two effects embedded in biological insurance theory, i.e. the effects of biodiversity on the mean and variability of ecosystem properties. This distinction allows explicit consideration of trade‐offs between the mean and stability of ecosystem processes and services. We also review applications of biological insurance theory in ecosystem management. Finally, we provide a synthetic conceptual framework that unifies the various approaches across disciplines, and we suggest new ways in which biological insurance theory could be extended to address new issues in ecology and ecosystem management. Exciting future challenges include linking the effects of biodiversity on ecosystem functioning and stability, incorporating multiple functions and feedbacks, developing new approaches to partition biodiversity effects across scales, extending biological insurance theory to complex interaction networks, and developing new applications to biodiversity and ecosystem management.
abstract_zh: 生物保险理论预测，在多变的环境中，由于某些物种或表型的表现或丰度下降，会被其他物种较为平缓的下降或增长至少部分抵消，因此群落多样性越高，总体生态系统属性的变化往往越小。在过去二十年中，生态学已积累了大量证据，证明生物多样性对生态系统功能具有稳定作用。随着生物保险理论日趋成熟，有必要重新审视并厘清其概念基础，以指导未来的发展、应用与测量。在本综述中，我们首先厘清了生态学中所用的保险与组合概念与启发它们的经济学概念之间的联系。这一梳理指出了生态学与经济学之间的缺口与错配，而这些缺口可以通过新的理论发展和新的管理应用加以有益地填补。其次，我们讨论了生物保险理论中一些迄今未被注意、却在其近期应用中显现出来的基本问题。特别是，我们明确区分了生物保险理论所包含的两种效应，即生物多样性对生态系统属性均值和变异性的影响。这一区分使得能够明确考虑生态系统过程与服务的均值和稳定性之间的权衡。我们还回顾了生物保险理论在生态系统管理中的应用。最后，我们提出了一个综合概念框架，统一了各学科的不同方法，并提出了新的途径，使生物保险理论得以拓展，以应对生态学和生态系统管理中的新问题。未来的挑战包括：将生物多样性对生态系统功能与稳定性的影响联系起来，纳入多种功能与反馈，发展新方法以划分不同尺度上的生物多样性效应，将生物保险理论拓展至复杂的相互作用网络，以及开发其在生物多样性和生态系统管理中的新应用。

title: Heat waves, climate change, and economic output
venue: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: Climate change is likely to affect economies not only through warming, but also via an increase in prolonged extreme events like heat waves. However, the impacts of heat waves on economic output are not well captured by standard empirical approaches that ignore when hot days occur. Using a global dataset spanning 1979–2016, we show agricultural losses from past heat waves are up to an order of magnitude larger than suggested by standard approaches. Combining these estimates with a suite of climate models implies that by the end of the century, climate damages in agriculture may be 5–10 times larger than is predicted by a focus on mean temperature shifts alone. These findings have important implications for targeting and evaluating climate adaptation efforts.
abstract_zh: 气候变化不仅可能通过气温升高影响经济，还可能通过热浪等持续性极端事件的增加产生影响。然而，标准的实证方法忽略了高温日出现的时间，因而无法很好地刻画热浪对经济产出的影响。利用覆盖1979–2016年的全球数据集，我们发现过去热浪造成的农业损失可能比标准方法所显示的大一个数量级。将这些估计与一系列气候模式相结合可以推断，到本世纪末，农业领域的气候损害可能比仅关注平均气温变化时所预测的大5–10倍。这些发现对气候适应措施的目标选择与效果评估具有重要意义。

title: Causal forest estimation of heterogeneous and time-varying environmental policy effects
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Empirically evaluating environmental policies requires grappling with impacts that exhibit not only cross-sectional heterogeneity, but also variation across time. Phased policy roll-outs offer opportunities for improvement across cohorts and policy effects can grow or decay, especially when natural processes are involved. Focusing on a subset of these factors can lead to erroneous inference, while considering them jointly magnifies specification challenges. To address these challenges, I extend and apply causal forests, a nonparametric method for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects, to simultaneously examine how effects vary across time. I first adapt causal forests to a panel setting with staggered policy introduction by incorporating dynamic selection assumptions and estimators. After illustrating the method's performance on simulated data, I use it to reanalyze how individual quota programs have affected fisheries catches around the world. Estimates reveal substantial heterogeneity and time dependencies and suggest that longer policy exposure may be less beneficial than previously thought. More generally, the approach has potential value for evaluating impacts of a range of environmental policies as well as environmental shocks.
abstract_zh: 对环境政策进行实证评估，需要应对的不仅是横截面上的异质性影响，还有随时间的变化。分阶段推行的政策为跨队列的改进提供了机会，且政策效应可能增强或衰减，尤其是在涉及自然过程时。若只关注这些因素中的某一个，可能导致错误的推断；而同时考虑它们，则会加剧模型设定上的挑战。为应对这些挑战，我扩展并应用了因果森林（causal forests）方法（一种估计异质性处理效应的非参数方法），以同时考察效应如何随时间变化。我首先使该方法适用于具有交错政策引入的面板数据设定，纳入了动态选择假设与估计量。在模拟数据上展示该方法的表现之后，我用它重新分析了各国个体配额计划对渔业渔获量的影响。估计结果显示出显著的异质性和时间依赖性，并表明政策暴露时间越长，其益处可能不如先前认为的那样大。更广泛地说，该方法在评估一系列环境政策以及环境冲击的影响方面具有潜在价值。

title: Cooperation as a solution to shared resources in territorial use rights in fisheries
abstract: Territorial use rights in fisheries (TURFs) are coastal territories assigned to fishermen for the exclusive extraction of marine resources. Recent evidence shows that the incentives that arise from these systems can improve fisheries sustainability. Although research on TURFs has increased in recent years, important questions regarding the social and ecological dynamics underlying their success remain largely unanswered. In particular, in order to create new successful TURFs, it is critical to comprehend how fish movement over different distances affects the development of sustainable fishing practices within a TURF. In theory, excessive spillover outside a TURF will generate incentives to overharvest. However, many TURFs have proven successful even when targeted species move over distances far greater than the TURF's size. A common attribute among some of these successful systems is the presence of inter‐TURF cooperation arrangements. This raises the question of how different levels and types of cooperation affect the motivations for overharvesting driven by the movement of fish outside the TURF. In this paper, we examine equilibrium yields under different levels of inter‐TURF cooperation (from partial to full) and varying degrees of asymmetry across TURFs of both biological capacity and benefit‐sharing. We find that partial cooperation can improve yields even with an unequal distribution of shared benefits and asymmetric carrying capacity. However, cooperation arrangements are unstable if the sharing agreement and biological asymmetries are misaligned. Remarkably, we find that asymmetry in the system can lead to the creation of voluntary no‐take zones.
abstract_zh: 领海使用权（TURFs）是指被分配给渔民、用于独占性开采海洋资源的沿海区域。近期证据表明，这类制度所产生的激励可以提高渔业的可持续性。尽管对TURFs的研究近年来有所增加，但有关其成功背后社会与生态动态的重要问题仍大多悬而未决。特别是，要建立新的成功TURFs，理解鱼类在不同距离上的移动如何影响TURF内可持续捕捞做法的形成，至关重要。理论上，过多的溢出（鱼类逸出TURF）将产生过度捕捞的激励。然而，许多TURFs即使在目标物种的移动距离远大于TURF自身面积的情况下，依然取得了成功。这些成功体系的一个共同特征，是存在TURF之间的合作安排。这就引出了一个问题：不同程度和类型的合作，如何影响因鱼类移出TURF而产生的过度捕捞动机。在本文中，我们考察了从部分合作到完全合作等不同合作水平下的均衡产量，以及在生物承载力和收益分享方面存在不同程度不对称的TURF之间的均衡产量。我们发现，即使共享收益分配不均、承载力不对称，部分合作也可以提高产量。然而，如果分享协议与生物学上的不对称性不一致，合作安排则是不稳定的。值得注意的是，我们发现系统中的不对称性可能导致自愿形成禁渔区。

title: Feasible Generalized Least Squares Using Machine Learning
Optimal harvest responses to environmental forecasts depend on resource knowledge and how it can be used
venue: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
abstract: Managing natural resources under large-scale environmental fluctuations like the El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is likely to become increasingly important under climate change. Forecasts of environmental conditions are improving, but the best response to an unfavorable forecast remains unclear; many practitioners advocate reducing harvest as a more precautionary approach, while prior economic theory favors increasing harvest. Using logistic and age-structured fisheries models, we show that informational constraints — uncertain stock estimates and restrictions on harvest policies — play a central role in choosing how to respond to a forecasted shock. With perfect knowledge and no policy constraints, risk-neutral managers should increase harvest when a negative shock is forecast. However, informational constraints may drive the optimal response to a forecast of a negative shock toward or away from precaution. Precautionary forecast responses arise when informational constraints make the harvest policy insufficiently sensitive to the true resource status. In contrast, uncertainty about the stock size can lead to more aggressive forecast responses when stock dynamics are nonlinear and not all fish are susceptible to fishing.
abstract_zh: 在气候变化背景下，管理厄尔尼诺—南方涛动（ENSO）等大尺度环境波动下的自然资源将变得日益重要。环境状况预报正在改进，但对不利预报的最佳应对方式仍不明确：许多从业者主张减少捕捞作为更为审慎的做法，而以往的经济理论则倾向于增加捕捞。利用逻辑斯谛模型和年龄结构渔业模型，我们表明，信息约束（包括对种群存量的不确定估计以及对捕捞政策的限制）在决定如何应对预报冲击方面起着核心作用。在信息完全且无政策约束的情况下，风险中性的管理者在预报出现负面冲击时应当增加捕捞。然而，信息约束可能使对负面冲击预报的最优应对趋向于审慎或偏离审慎。当信息约束使捕捞政策对资源真实状况的敏感度不足时，就会出现审慎的预报应对。相反，当存量动态呈非线性且并非所有鱼类都易受捕捞时，存量规模的不确定性可能导致更为激进的预报应对。

title: Using a Marginal Value Approach to Integrate Ecological and Economic Objectives across the Minnesota Landscape
Are Territorial Use Rights in Fisheries (TURFs) Sufficiently Large?
Protecting Marine Ecosystems: Prescriptive Regulation Versus Market Incentives
abstract: Tradable harvest rights are gradually replacing prescriptive regulations in the management of commercial fisheries. We provide evidence that this management strategy can also successfully achieve non-commercial marine conservation goals, such as limiting unintended catch (bycatch) of protected species. We examine fishers’ responses to the introduction of tradable harvest rights for protected species, ‘bycatch rights,’ in the US West Coast groundfish fishery, finding evidence of adjustment along several margins and estimating the marginal cost of conservation. Fishers adapted to bycatch rights by changing fishing location, gear, time of day fished, and duration of fishing activity. As a result, catches of protected species fell dramatically. The nuanced nature of fishers’ responses indicates that the least-cost way of achieving conservation goals can involve fine-tuned behavioral adaptations that would be difficult or impossible to achieve with command-and-control regulation.
abstract_zh: 可转让捕捞权正在逐步取代商业渔业管理中的规定性监管。我们提供证据表明，这一管理策略同样能够成功实现非商业性的海洋保护目标，例如限制对受保护物种的意外捕获（兼捕）。我们考察了美国西海岸底层鱼类渔业中，渔民对为受保护物种引入的可转让捕捞权（“兼捕权”）的反应，发现渔民在多个维度上做出了调整，并估算了保护的边际成本。渔民通过改变捕捞地点、渔具、捕捞时段以及作业持续时间来适应兼捕权。结果，受保护物种的捕获量大幅下降。渔民反应的细微之处表明，实现保护目标的最低成本途径可能涉及精细调整的行为适应，而这是指令—控制型监管难以甚至无法实现的。

title: Functional diversity of catch mitigates negative effects of temperature variability on fisheries yields
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society B
abstract: Temperature variation within a year can impact biological processes driving population abundances. The implications for the ecosystem services these populations provide, including food production from marine fisheries, are poorly understood. Whether and how temperature variability impacts fishery yields may depend on the number of harvested species and differences in their responses to varying temperatures. Drawing from previous theoretical and empirical studies, we predict that greater temperature variability within years will reduce yields, but harvesting a larger number of species, especially a more functionally diverse set, will decrease this impact. Using a global marine fisheries dataset, we find that within-year temperature variability reduces yields, but current levels of functional diversity (FD) of targeted species, measured using traits related to species' responses to temperature, largely offset this effect. Globally, high FD of catch could avoid annual losses in yield of 6.8% relative to projections if FD were degraded to the lowest level observed in the data. By contrast, species richness in the catch and in the ecosystem did not provide a similar mitigating effect. This work provides novel empirical evidence that short-term temperature variability can negatively impact the provisioning of ecosystem services, but that FD can buffer these negative impacts.
abstract_zh: 一年之内的温度变化会影响驱动种群丰度的生物过程。这些种群所提供的生态系统服务（包括海洋渔业的粮食生产）会受到何种影响，目前所知甚少。年内温度变异是否以及如何影响渔业产量，可能取决于被捕捞物种的数量及其对不同温度响应的差异。基于先前的理论与实证研究，我们预测：年内温度变异越大，产量越低；但捕捞更多物种，尤其是功能多样性更高的物种组合，将减轻这一影响。利用全球海洋渔业数据集，我们发现，年内温度变异会降低产量，但目标物种当前的功能多样性（FD，以与物种温度响应相关的性状衡量）在很大程度上抵消了这一效应。在全球范围内，若将FD降至数据中观察到的最低水平，较高的渔获物FD可避免相对于预测值每年6.8%的产量损失。相比之下，渔获物和生态系统中的物种丰富度并未表现出类似的缓冲作用。这项工作提供了新的实证证据：短期温度变异会对生态系统服务的供给产生负面影响，但功能多样性可以缓冲这些负面影响。
